description: Offer three fixed framework layout examples (Vite, Astro, Next.js), not goal-based tool discovery. For tools matching a task, call find_mcp_tools and search the actual catalog. The IDE creates any requested mockup using its own available capabilities. Kloudy performs no model or image generation. Selection is presentation only; no install, account connection or spending consent.
